name: Barcola
brief: Fill the right-wing gap left by Salah; not like-for-like (more left-sided, pace and 1v1 for Iraola's direct style); expected to lead the attack

name: Diomande
brief: Part of Mourinho's squad overhaul after two trophyless seasons: judge mainly on team improvement plus his share of team goal contributions; one of six signings, so team gains cannot be credited to him alone
notes: Started 4 of 9 league games; competes with Guler (playmaker) for the right side. Theory to test: Mourinho prefers a creator feeding Mbappe and Vinicius on the counter

name: Savio
brief: Long-term target; immediate starter on either wing with Maddison, Kulusevski, Kudus, Simons and Odobert injured; lacked regular starts at City
notes: Injured 18 Oct, expected back early Nov; limited baseline minutes (821)

name: Gordon
brief: Style fit for Flick and more intensity (Deco); keep the attack's energy when Raphinha is off; preferred over Rashford. Pressing not stated explicitly
notes: Pressing per 90 (tackles + interceptions + recoveries) 2.72 vs Rashford 2.76 last season; small sample (496 mins)

name: G.Ramos
brief: Fix the scoring problem: Milan scored 53 league goals, nobody reached 10, top scorer Leao wants out; first Amorim signing; bench role at PSG
